```text
# PR #4940: Patch: the AI's redaction hides the tags of the opponent's face-down Trap in the play counts, and the hidden card an interrupted trap firing remembers

Closes #4804

## What changed

`redact` (`crates/ai/src/observe.rs`) now gives the same output for two worlds that differ only in a card the seat can't see. There were two leaks, and both are fixed.

1. **Play counts.** A new `forget_face_down_plays` runs before step 3, which turns hidden cards into placeholders. It handles every hidden card on the opponent's backrow that they own, on top or in a pile beneath (B5 E21):
   - its tags come off `game_log.played_by_tag`;
   - its set comes off `game_log.played_by_set`, and the field becomes `None` when it empties;
   - if it was played this turn (its id is in `turn_log.played_ids`), it is moved from its own type to `Trap` in `played_by_type`.

   No count goes below 0, and a count that reaches 0 is removed. Placeholders have no definition and are skipped, so redacting twice is the same as redacting once.
2. **Interrupted trap firing.** `scrub_resume` now also scrubs `resume.data.firing.event`, the event that `traps::owe_firing` parks on `state.work` under `@trapFiring`.

There is no engine change: state shape, replay hashes and `apps/web/src/wire` are untouched. `classify` reads the change as `Internal`.

The rule is written down as ruling **R4804000** (`spec/rulings/R4804000.md`), with its §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/4804.md`. The "`decide` reads only `redact`" list in `crates/ai/README.md` now names both fixes.

## Tests

New file `crates/ai/tests/ai/redact_two_worlds.rs`. Each test builds two worlds through `reduce`, checks that the seat's view of both is the same, and checks that their redactions don't differ at any JSON path:
- `r4804000_redact_hides_the_tags_of_the_opponents_face_down_trap`: the issue's first reproduction. Sheepish against Crop Dusting. The true Plague count is 1 and the redacted one is 0; redacting twice gives the same hash.
- `r4804000_redact_counts_the_opponents_face_down_play_this_turn_as_a_trap`: Sheepish (a Trap) against Bread and Butter (a Field Trap). The true `{FieldTrap: 1}` redacts to `{Trap: 1}`.
- `r4804000_redact_hides_the_set_of_the_opponents_face_down_trap`: Overflow Error (Infinite Assault, AI tag) against Sheepish. The redaction has `played_by_set == None` and an AI count of 0. The held-set card does play in a scenario, so this path is really tested.
- `r4804000_redact_keeps_the_opponents_face_up_plays_and_the_seats_own_counts`: Pestilent Slime's face-up Plague and Unit stay, and the AI's own log is unchanged.
- `r185_redact_scrubs_the_event_an_interrupted_trap_firing_keeps`: the issue's second reproduction. It also checks that the parked event's `defId` becomes `ai:hidden`.

In `crates/ai/tests/ai/observe.rs`, `mutate_hidden` now moves the play counts along with a swapped hidden backrow card (`recount_face_down_play`). Its rng draws are unchanged.

To check that the tests catch the bugs, I turned the fixes off and ran them:
- With both `redact` fixes off, all five new tests fail, and so does `r185_b9_property_…`.
- With only the recount in `mutate_hidden` off, `r185_b9_property_…` fails.

Both edits were reverted afterwards.

Commands I ran, all passing:
- `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --test ai redact_two_worlds`: 5 passed
- `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --test ai redact`: 83 passed
- `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --test ai observe`: 46 passed (the B9 property, B10, B11 and R2102000 among them)
- `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --test ai`: 1075 passed, `pinned.rs` included
- `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --test ai_slow`: 104 passed, 15 ignored (the daily tests)
- `cargo test -p jackioh-shared --features jackioh-engine/testkit`: 331 and 682 passed
- `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-ai --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean
- `cargo jackioh spec check`: `2595 rulings, 6413 proofs, 78390 citations in 5029 files, 35439 links: ok`
- `cargo jackioh patches check`: ok
- `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims`: `Internal`

I did not run the whole-workspace suite; the harness runs it. One background shell loop I had started to wait on the AI suite was stopped at its time limit; the suite had already finished with the 1075 passes above.

## Decisions the issue did not settle

- **Cards in the resolving zone are left alone**, unlike the issue's note. A card waiting there to be set has not been counted yet (§10.5 step 4, R448), so taking its tags off would remove some other play's count.
- **The type moves to `Trap` only for this turn's plays**, because `played_by_type` only holds this turn.
- **`played_by_set` is included.** It leaks the same way, and Infinite Assault games are played against the AI.
- **The fix is a reading of the counts, not a record of them.**
  - A card set face-down by an effect (Recruit sets traps face-down) was never counted, but still loses its tags here.
  - A face-down card that went back to a hand keeps its tags in the count.

  The alternatives were dropping the opponent's counts entirely (rejected: it loses the face-up history the seat watched) or marking each face-down play on the state (rejected: it would change the replay hash of every game that holds one). The ruling says all of this.
- **Not done: the issue's third place.** At the opponent's open prompt, `redact` keeps `pending.resume`, whose `defId` and `data.codeOffers` can name hidden cards. Blanking it isn't safe: `view_for` reads `pending.resume.def_id` and `instance_id` to show who is asking and how many options, so a blank resume would break the B10 view mirror. `decide` returns `None` at that point, so nothing reads it today. It needs its own issue, which a person or the next audit should file.
- **Small departures from the plan:**
  - The tests don't import `indexmap::IndexMap`, because the testkit glob already exports it.
  - The mutation skips swaps where the picked card is the original.
  - The Field Trap test uses Bread and Butter (core-018); the fallback core-071 wasn't needed.

## Worth a second look

- `recount_face_down_play` in the property mirrors `forget_face_down_plays` exactly: the same `owner == opp` filter, the same removal at 0, the same `None` for an empty set map, and a type move only when the count is above 0. If one of them changes, the other must change with it.
- Every card script that reads these counts reads its own controller's, and no glow (`conditionActive`) reads the opponent's. A face-up opposing Unit whose stats come from them (Scaling Law) keeps its shown stats through R602's existing correction. So the view and the redaction stay in step.
- I ran one read-only `git fetch origin main` so that `classify --base origin/main` had a base. Nothing was pushed.
```

**Issue #4804 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #4804: Patch: the AI's redaction hides the tags of the opponent's face-down Trap in the play counts, and the hidden card an interrupted trap firing remembers
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

### What happens

Two places where `redact` (`crates/ai/src/observe.rs`) keeps something the seat may not see, so two true states that look alike to the seat redact differently. Neither was turned into a changed decision; both break R185's invariant on `redact`'s own output, and both are read by simulated steps.

**1. The opponent's `gameLog.playedByTag` counts a face-down Trap by its tags.**
`crates/engine/src/play_counts.rs` `record_play` counts every play by `tags_of(card)`, a face-down Trap's included, and never resets it (only `last_face_up_play` skips Traps). `redact` never touches `players[opp].game_log.played_by_tag`. So after the opponent sets a (1) Trap face-down, the redacted state says which tags it carries: core-041 Sheepish (no tag) against classic-063 Crop Dusting (Plague) differ at exactly `.players.p2.gameLog.playedByTag.Plague`, while `view_for(state, seat)` is identical for the two (the test asserts that first). Every simulated card that reads `query::played_this_game_with_tag` of that player gets the true count (C+ #64 Mulch Muncher reads Fruit, T-AI-02 Scaling Law reads AI). By reading only: `turn_log.played_by_type` leaks the same way for the turn of the set (Trap against Field Trap against a Cloaked card's type), which `view_for` scrubs to `Trap`.

**2. An interrupted trap firing keeps the whole event under `resume.data.firing.event`.**
`scrub_resume` (`observe.rs:473-479`) scrubs only `resume.data["event"]`. When a trap's firing is interrupted by a prompt, `crates/engine/src/traps.rs` `owe_firing` parks the rest of it on `state.work` as `@trapFiring` with the full `TrapFiring`, its `event: GameEvent` included, under `data["firing"]`. Scene: the AI holds a face-down C #9 Income Tax; the opponent plays Stockpile, its second draw fires the Tax, and the opponent's keep prompt interrupts the firing. The parked item carries the `drawn` event with the `instanceId` and `defId` of a card now in the opponent's hand: two worlds that differ only in that card redact differently at exactly `.work[0].resume.data.firing.event.defId`. The copy of the same event in the prompt's own `resume.data.event` is scrubbed correctly. `run_owed_firing` hands the unscrubbed event to the trap's remaining triggers when a simulation continues the item.

### What should happen

`crates/ai/README.md`, "`decide` reads only `redact`": "two states that differ only in hidden cards give the same decision under the same rng", and `redact` "strips from the events its queues keep what `view_for` strips of a hidden card". R185. `view_for` sends neither `playedByTag` nor the `instanceId` and `defId` of a `drawn` the viewer may not read.

### How to reproduce

Two differential tests fail on `main` (3a83bd7), in [`crates/ai/tests/audit_hidden.rs` at bf24a52](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/blob/bf24a52273bd5c0e7d6f9c740b28a8d7cb7f2b3e/crates/ai/tests/audit_hidden.rs) (branch `claude/vigilant-mayer-pmyrhr`): `redact_hides_the_tags_of_the_opponents_face_down_trap` and `redact_scrubs_the_event_an_interrupted_trap_firing_keeps`. Each builds two worlds through `reduce` that differ only in a hidden card, serializes `redact` of both, and lists every JSON path where they differ (the file's `diff_paths` helper).

Output today:

```
redact tells the two worlds apart at: [
    ".players.p2.gameLog.playedByTag.Plague (one side only)",
]
redact tells the two worlds apart at: [
    ".work[0].resume.data.firing.event.defId: \"core-016\" vs \"core-053\"",
]
```

The second scene, for reference:

```rust
let start = scenario(json!({
    "seed": "audit-hidden-owed-firing", "active": "p2", "turn": 8,
    "p1": { "hand": ["core-008"], "backrow": [{ "def": "classic-009", "faceUp": false }],
            "library": ["core-020", "core-053", "core-019"] },
    "p2": { "hand": ["core-005", "core-011"], "mana": 5, "library": ["core-012", second, "core-012"] },
})).state().clone();
// p2 plays core-005 Stockpile; its keep prompt opens with the Tax's firing parked on `state.work`.
```

### Where

The AI: `crates/ai/src/observe.rs` (`redact`, `scrub_resume`).

### Version or commit

`main` at 3a83bd7.

### Notes for the fix

- For 1: for each hidden backrow, backrow-pile or resolving card the opponent played, take its tags off `players[opp].game_log.played_by_tag` (dropping keys that reach zero) and count its entry in `turn_log.played_by_type` as `Trap`, before the card becomes a placeholder. The seat's own log is not affected.
- For 2: in `scrub_resume`, also run `scrub_event_value` on `resume.data["firing"]["event"]` when it is an object.
- The existing tests pin neighbours of both, not these: `redact_play_records.rs` covers `last_spell` and `last_face_up_play`; `redact_queues.rs` and `redact_view_mirror.rs` cover `data.event` and dispatch events.
- A third place seen but not proven by a test, worth checking in the same change: at the opponent's open prompt, `redact` blanks the options but keeps `pending.resume` (`def_id`, `instance_id`, `data`); a scan of random games found states where `pending.resume.defId` named a card hidden from the seat, and one where `pending.resume.data.codeOffers[]` held the offered definitions. `decide` returns `None` there, so nothing reads it today.
- Add each field to the mutation property in `crates/ai/tests/ai/observe.rs` (`mutate_hidden`) if it fits there.
- Not among the findings of the AI audit tracker #4787, which read the redaction as clean.

Found by an audit of the AI crate; the reproductions were run and the code paths read before filing.

## Goal

`redact` (`crates/ai/src/observe.rs`) must give the same output for two true states that differ only in a card the seat cannot see (R185). Two leaks need fixing:

|---|---|---|
| `crates/ai/src/observe.rs` | change | new `take_one` and `forget_face_down_plays`, called in `redact` before Step 3; `scrub_resume` also scrubs `data.firing.event`; imports |
| `crates/ai/tests/ai/redact_two_worlds.rs` | new | five differential tests (below) |
| `crates/ai/tests/ai/mod.rs` | change | `pub mod redact_two_worlds;` |
| `crates/ai/tests/ai/observe.rs` | change | `mutate_hidden` moves the play counts along with a swapped hidden backrow card (`recount_face_down_play`, `take_one`) |
| `crates/ai/README.md` | change | "`decide` reads only `redact`" list |
| `spec/rulings/R4804000.md` | new | the ruling |
| `spec/pending/4804.md` | new | its §11 paragraph |

Do not touch:
- `crates/engine` (no engine change: state shape, replay hashes and `apps/web/src/wire` stay as they are), `crates/cards`, `apps/`.
- `spec/11-rulings.md`, `spec/INDEX.md`, `spec/history/`, `spec/CARDS.md`.
- `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, `.claude/`.

Do not run `cargo jackioh spec index`.

Governing rules: R185 and §9.9 (what the AI may know); R451 and §10.5 step 4 (the play counts, `crates/engine/src/play_counts.rs` `record_play`); R33 and R351 (a face-down card shows its back and cost); R227 (fresh id; `turn_log.played_ids` holds it); R448 (the announce window comes before step 4); R4593000 (`played_by_set`); R113 (`traps::owe_firing` / `run_owed_firing`).

## Steps

1. **`crates/ai/src/observe.rs`, imports.** Change `use indexmap::IndexSet;` to `use indexmap::{IndexMap, IndexSet};`. Add `Tag` to the `jackioh_engine::{…}` list. Add `use jackioh_engine::faces::card_type_of;` and `use jackioh_engine::query::tags_of;`. Use the full module paths so the root globs cannot make the names ambiguous.

/// One count less of `key`; a count reaching 0 is removed (R4804000).
fn take_one<K: std::hash::Hash + Eq>(counts: &mut IndexMap<K, i32>, key: &K) {
    match counts.get_mut(key) {
        Some(count) if *count > 1 => *count -= 1,
        Some(_) => {
            counts.shift_remove(key);
        }
        None => {}
    }
}

/// R4804000, R451: the opponent's play counts as the seat saw them. A card the seat cannot see on the
/// opponent's backrow (its top or a pile beneath it, B5 E21) that they own is taken for a face-down
/// play of theirs, which the seat saw only as a Trap being set (R33, R448): its tags and its
/// single-player set come off their per-game counts, and a play of it this turn (its R227 id among
/// `playedIds`) counts as a Trap. A card waiting in the resolving zone to be set has not been counted
/// yet (§10.5 step 4). A placeholder (a state already redacted) has nothing left to take.
fn forget_face_down_plays(state: &GameState, next: &mut GameState, opp: PlayerId, hidden: &IndexSet<String>) {
    let side = &state.players[opp];
    let tops = side.backrow.iter().flatten();
    let dormant = side.backrow_piles.iter().flatten().flatten();
    for card in tops.chain(dormant) {
        if card.owner != opp || !hidden.contains(&card.id) {
            continue;
        }
        let Some(def) = find_def(Some(state), &card.def_id) else {
            continue;
        };
        let tags: IndexSet<Tag> = tags_of(state, card).into_iter().collect();
        let type_ = card_type_of(state, card);
        let played_now = side.turn_log.played_ids.contains(&card.id);
        let counts = &mut next.players[opp];
        if let Some(log) = counts.game_log.as_mut() {
            for tag in &tags {
                take_one(&mut log.played_by_tag, tag);
            }
            if let Some(by_set) = log.played_by_set.as_mut() {
                take_one(by_set, &def.set);
                if by_set.is_empty() {
                    log.played_by_set = None;
                }
            }
        }
        if played_now
            && type_ != CardType::Trap
            && let Some(types) = counts.turn_log.played_by_type.as_mut()
            && types.get(&type_).is_some_and(|count| *count > 0)
        {
            take_one(types, &type_);
            *types.entry(CardType::Trap).or_insert(0) += 1;
        }
    }
}
```

/// R4804000: in a world where the opponent's hidden backrow card is `picked`, their counts hold
/// `picked`'s tags, set and type where they held the card's (`redact`'s reading, run backwards).
fn recount_face_down_play(out: &mut GameState, opp: PlayerId, card: &CardInstance, picked: &str) {
    let mut now = card.clone();
    now.def_id = picked.to_string();
    let was: IndexSet<Tag> = jackioh_engine::query::tags_of(out, card).into_iter().collect();
    let is: IndexSet<Tag> = jackioh_engine::query::tags_of(out, &now).into_iter().collect();
    let was_set = find_def(Some(&*out), &card.def_id).map(|def| def.set);
    let is_set = find_def(Some(&*out), picked)
        .map(|def| def.set)
        .filter(|set| SINGLE_PLAYER_SETS.contains(set) || HELD_SINGLE_PLAYER_SETS.contains(set));
    let was_type = jackioh_engine::faces::card_type_of(out, card);
    let is_type = jackioh_engine::faces::card_type_of(out, &now);
    let played_now = out.players[opp].turn_log.played_ids.contains(&card.id);
    let side = &mut out.players[opp];
    if let Some(log) = side.game_log.as_mut() {
        for tag in &was { take_one(&mut log.played_by_tag, tag); }
        for tag in is { *log.played_by_tag.entry(tag).or_insert(0) += 1; }
        if let (Some(set), Some(by_set)) = (was_set, log.played_by_set.as_mut()) { take_one(by_set, &set); }
        if log.played_by_set.as_ref().is_some_and(IndexMap::is_empty) { log.played_by_set = None; }
        if let Some(set) = is_set { *log.played_by_set.get_or_insert_with(IndexMap::new).entry(set).or_insert(0) += 1; }
    }
    if played_now
        && let Some(types) = side.turn_log.played_by_type.as_mut()
        && types.get(&was_type).is_some_and(|count| *count > 0)
    {
        take_one(types, &was_type);
        *types.entry(is_type).or_insert(0) += 1;
    }
}

## Risks

- **The property breaks.** If step 5 is skipped, the B9 property and B11 tests fail: the base subtracts card X's tags and the mutation subtracts card Y's. Keep the helper exactly mirroring step 2's arithmetic: same `owner == opp` filter, same floor-at-0, same `None` for an empty set map, and a type move only when the count is above 0.
- **Idempotence.** A second `redact` sees placeholders, which have no `find_def`. They must be skipped, or the counts drop twice or `tags_of` panics.
- **Not exact, by design.**
  - Recruited, transformed or stolen face-down cards and face-down cards bounced to a hand (`effects/summon.rs`, `transform.rs`, `steal.rs`, `move_.rs`) can leave a count wrong; the ruling states this.
  - An engine-side record would change replay hashes, so it is out of scope.
- **No engine or wire change.** Fuzz, the golden fold and replays are unaffected. Only the AI's redacted copy changes, so a decision can move only where a simulated card reads the opponent's tag or type counts. If `pinned.rs` fails, check whether such a read drives it. Do not re-pin a fixture without that evidence, and report it.
- **Purity (rule 4).** No new dependency.

## Open questions

- **Third place in the issue (left out on purpose).** At the opponent's open prompt, `redact` keeps `pending.resume`, whose `defId` can name a card the seat cannot see and whose `data.codeOffers` can hold offered definitions. It cannot simply be blanked: `view_for`'s `shown_option_count` (`crates/engine/src/view_for.rs` ~1797–1803) and the asker it shows (~1779) read `pending.resume.def_id` and `instance_id`, so a blank resume would break the B10 view mirror. A fix must blank only what `view_for` hides. That deserves its own issue, filed by a person or the next audit. `decide` returns `None` there today.
- **Where the issue's notes were not followed.**
  - Resolving-zone cards are left out: they have not been counted yet (R448).
  - The type move is limited to this turn's `playedIds`: `played_by_type` holds only this turn.
  - `played_by_set` is included: it is the same leak, and Infinite Assault games are played against the AI.

  A person may overrule any of these.
````
